title: First Bath
desc: Splashes, wide eyes, and a very cautious pair of parents — your first bath was an adventure for all of us.
story: Your Maami held you gently in the bathroom sink while Mum slowly and carefully gave you your very first bath. Dad was far too scared to get involved and stood back watching with wide eyes and his heart in his mouth. You cried and cried, and all of our hearts were beating very fast. But the moment we wrapped you up snug in your towel, you settled straight away. Just like that, the crying stopped and peace returned. It was quite the adventure, and one none of us will ever forget.
